replaces: 259 per-brief *.rubric.json files under research/edge-case-corpus/tools/, all with identical structure and exactly two criteria (R-clearance centre_distance >= 0.5 m, R-nocoll), both already enforced more strictly by gate C3 (true OBB clearance <= 5.0 m) and C5 (zero collisions). They pre-registered nothing about any mechanism and could not reject anything the gate would not already reject.
vocabulary: packages/sim-engine/src/trace/intent-rubric.ts, evaluated by `uniscenarios evaluate <trace> --rubric <file>` -- executable, not prose.
policy: One rubric per taxonomy category. Bands are taken from published protocols (Euro NCAP CCRs/CCRb/CPFA/CPNA/CPNCO/CBNA, UN R157, UN R13-H, ISO 3888-2, NHTSA pre-crash typology, MUTCD Part 6) and were fixed BEFORE any replay. What the vocabulary cannot express is recorded as an explicit `unsupported` criterion rather than quietly dropped.

supersedes.reason: v1 C5.pedestrian carried a clearance criterion with pair ["ego","*"]. There is no such actor, so the criterion evaluated as UNCHECKED and an unchecked required criterion rejects: five C5 archetypes were rejected with pass:3 fail:0. That is a defect in the rubric, not a finding about the corpus, and it is recorded rather than quietly fixed. v2 replaces it with an explicit `unsupported` criterion; true OBB clearance is already enforced by gate C3.
